reason: The cited evidence (E1) supports the first two premises regarding σ phase coarsening at grain boundaries above 950 K and its detrimental effect on properties. However, it provides no specific support for the remaining three premises concerning the differential effects of oxidizing vs. reducing atmospheres, the role of residual stresses, or the specific alloy composition Al0.2Co1.5CrFeNi1.5Ti0.3.
premises: σ phase coarsens and preferentially locates at grain boundaries above ~950 K in this alloy class
Grain boundary σ phase reduces mechanical and chemical properties
Oxidizing environment promotes diffusional segregation and grain boundary precipitation of embrittling oxides and σ-like phases
Reducing environment suppresses oxide formation at boundaries, leading to more uniform precipitation and delayed failure
Residual stresses from SLM interact with environmental effects to influence degradation
